title: Christ-centred spiritual teaching on Revelation (chapter-by-chapter series, summarised)
author: Spiritual-understanding teachers
summary: A chapter-by-chapter teaching approach that reads Revelation as the unveiling of Jesus Christ and his finished work, interpreting its symbols as present spiritual realities of union with Christ and new creation rather than as a calendar of future catastrophes.
note: Summarised from the publicly stated principles of a chapter-by-chapter teaching series; the series itself could not be accessed directly.
